title: Deputy GC: Blue Heron Mutual – Who Has Called?

fields.subject: Blue Heron Mutual – who has called?
fields.body:
Priya, [General Counsel],

Quick check. Has anyone called the Blue Heron Mutual claims line yet? I can't find a claim number in the CMT log.

The cyber policy needs notice within 24 hours. It also needs the insurer's prior consent before we retain forensic or legal vendors. Blackwater Cyber started work at 15:00 CT. Harrow Fenn LLP sent the attached engagement letter at 15:41 CT. Neither is consented yet.

Harrow Fenn also wants the CFO's preliminary impact range before the 19:00 CT Disclosure Committee. They say "not yet determined" is acceptable only if it comes with the facts we have and the plan to determine.

The broker's after-hours desk closes intake at 17:00 CT. If we miss that, the next intake is tomorrow morning.

Who is making the call? I'll record the claim number and time in the minutes.

Exercise aid, not legal advice. Check the current rule and your counsel.
fields.signature:
Alan Ferreira
Deputy General Counsel
Ironcrest Machinery Corporation | Legal Department
Privileged & Confidential – Attorney-Client Communication

instructorNote: This pressure inject tests whether the CFO calls the Blue Heron Mutual claims line through the broker before 17:00. Watch for her to log the claim number and ask for written consent for Blackwater Cyber and Harrow Fenn. The GC should sign once consent arrives. Also watch for a commitment to a dated impact range for 19:00 (about $8.5M per lost day against the $60M prompt, with assumptions) and for a flag that the D&O carrier gets any disclosure.
